structure_review.figure: Scheme 1, sole newly studied emitter PXZ-TPB-CN (pointer only)
structure_review.rationale: Legacy evidence E01 explicitly names PXZ-TPB-CN, as does Scheme 1. The source-target assignment is resolved. However, the inherited SMILES contains six aryl substituents on the central benzene whereas the source has four. Remove the two excess phenyl groups; the synthesis precursor independently confirms the substitution pattern within the same paper.
structure_review.limitations: Source-drawn repair, not expert certification. Some source text says PXZ-TPE-CN; use the Scheme 1 designation while retaining the naming inconsistency. SI and CCDC 1982004 remain uninspected.

notes: The source-drawn four-substituted core replaces the inherited six-substituted core in this draft; independent review remains pending.
